author: Dpu
body:
IGN: Dpu

Ok so I was recently banned on the server apparently because I was using "Toggle Sneak". First of all, I don't think that should be bannable because that's a mod, not part of a hack client. Second of all if this is a rule of yours in which toggle sneak is considered "hacking" then I didn't know, however I was still not using it. Yes, I was shifting for like a minute but that was because I was trying to hide from the opponents. Someone did say that I was running and shifting but I wasn't on my screen and sometimes it just glitches like that. You can ask anyone on at that time, like Zerohh or something, I think Thrasilias was on and a bunch of other dudes. The point is I was not "hacking" in any way shape or form. Please unban me, this is a big mistake. And for the mod who banned me, no hard feelings and no offence but try and get some better proof before you perm ban someone

https://gyazo.com/4e41ad07dcee6e05138f7a0ffc13afab
